# Lerus Training

> > Lerus Training provides OPITO, GWO, and Bureau Veritas certified offshore safety and maritime training across 8 countries including Ukraine, Indonesia, Singapore, Malaysia, and Turkey.

Lerus specializes in offshore industry training for oil & gas and wind energy sectors, offering courses in dynamic positioning, crane operations, helideck emergency response, QHSE safety management, and barge operations. Training is delivered through state-of-the-art simulators including Full Mission Class A Offshore Vessel simulators and meets international standards from OPITO, Global Wind Organisation, Bureau Veritas, and IMO Resolution A.1079(28).

## Key Topics

- OPITO certified training
- GWO BST (Basic Safety Training)
- Bureau Veritas certification
- Dynamic Positioning (DP CPD)
- Offshore safety and QHSE
- Helideck emergency response
- Crane operations
- Barge supervisor training
- IMO Resolution A.1079(28)
- Global Wind Organisation standards
- Maritime simulation training
- Offshore wind energy training
- Ship handling and towing operations
- Jack-up barge stability
- HSE certification

## GWO Wind Energy Training

- [GWO BST Offshore Training PACKAGE 2026](https://www.lerus.com/offshore-courses/gwo/gwo-bst-offshore-package.html): GWO certified BST offshore training package for wind energy industry
- [GWO BST Offshore Refresher Training PACKAGE - Indonesia](https://www.lerus.com/gwo-bst-offshore-refresher-package-indonesia.html): GWO BST refresher package for offshore wind industry in Indonesia
- [GWO Sea Survival (SS) Training - Ukraine](https://www.lerus.com/sea-survival-ss-module.html): GWO sea survival training for offshore wind operations in Ukraine
- [GWO Manual Handling Refresher (MHR) Training - Ukraine](https://www.lerus.com/manual-handling-refresher-mhr-module.html): GWO manual handling refresher for wind turbine operations in Ukraine

## OPITO Helideck Operations

- [OPITO Helideck Operations Initial Training (HOIT) - Indonesia](https://www.lerus.com/helideck-operations-initial-training-hoit.html): OPITO HOIT training for HLO and HDA roles in Indonesia
- [OPITO Helideck Emergency Response Team Member Further Training (HERTMF) 2026](https://www.lerus.com/offshore-courses/opito/helideck-emergency-response-team-member-further-training-hertm-f.html): OPITO certified HERTMF refresher for helideck emergency response teams
- [OPITO Helideck Emergency Response Team Leader Further Training (HERTL F) - Ukraine](https://www.lerus.com/helideck-emergency-response-team-leader-further-training-hertl-f.html): OPITO HERTL refresher training for helideck team leaders in Ukraine

## QHSE Safety Management

- [QHSE Level 1 - Turkey](https://www.lerus.com/qhse-level-1-232.html): QHSE Level 1 training in Turkiye for oil-and-gas industry safety mgmt
- [QHSE Level 2 2026](https://www.lerus.com/offshore-courses/qhse/qhse-level-2.html): Bureau Veritas certified QHSE Level 2 offshore safety management
- [QHSE Courses in Ukraine](https://www.lerus.com/courses/ukraine/qhse.html): Bureau Veritas certified QHSE safety courses in Ukraine

- [Jack-Up Stability Course - Singapore](https://www.lerus.com/jack-up-stability.html): IMO A.1079(28) jack-up stability course in Singapore
